q: Which Roman emperor expelled Epictetus and other philosophers from Rome?
explain: Domitian expelled philosophers from Rome, irritated by the favourable reception Stoics gave to opponents of his tyranny.
hook: Domitian dominated, so the philosophers departed.

sources.title: Epictetus | Britannica
sources.quote: In ad 90 he was expelled from Rome with other philosophers by the emperor Domitian, who was irritated by the favourable reception given by Stoics to opponents of his tyranny.

q: What does the Latin phrase 'memento mori' literally mean?
explain: Memento mori is Latin for 'remember that you must die'; in English it names a reminder of mortality.

sources.title: MEMENTO MORI Definition & Meaning - Merriam-Webster
sources.quote: Memento mori literally means "Remember you must die".
